purpose: Fast repository index for targeted future changes. Verify the relevant source files before editing.

communication.behavior: One direct thread per normalized user pair, group messaging, receipts, typing, presence, mentions, actions, attachments, and polling fallback.

portal_voucher_delivery.behavior: Distributes each canonical student fee voucher to the student, linked parents, and assigned class teacher with recipient-scoped history, PDF access, notifications, popup dismissal, and view/download tracking.

login.responsibility: Role selection, authentication entry points, and role-aware redirects.

admin_panel.responsibility: Administration, academics, HR, appraisal, timetable, procurement, fleet, dashboards, and shared admin UI.

admin_ai.responsibility: Admin AI copilot, analytics, reports, student intelligence, tool execution, planning, and conversation memory.

ai_tutor.responsibility: Student AI tutor conversations, retrieval-augmented knowledge, safety, prompts, and tutor UI.

teacher_dashboard.responsibility: Teacher portal, LMS, attendance, lesson planning, assessments, result entry, and teacher workflows.

student_profile.responsibility: Student portal, profile, attendance, results, assignments, quizzes, diary, timetable, and notifications.

parent_dashboard.responsibility: Parent portal and child-facing academic information.

exam_system.responsibility: Exam definitions, paper generation, question bank, marks, grading, analytics, and exam workflows.

edupilot_core.responsibility: Accounts, fees, salary, payments, notifications, automation, timetable fixtures, and generic data CRUD.
